name: netatmo
description: A weather display web application for presenting temperature information gathered by locally installed Netatmo weather sensors.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm run build:svg && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend run build
scripts.deploy: npm run install:all && npm run build && npm run start

author: Mikko Siikaniemi
